notes.title: Small fix
notes.content: Fix the German translation of the tutorial

notes.title: Collectibles Update
notes.content:
A collectibles system has been added: destroying asteroids now has a 10% chance to drop a collectible item. The more you collect, the harder it will be to obtain the next ones.

These collectibles can be viewed in the new dedicated tab within the game.

No new achievements have been added, respecting players who have already completed everything and earned the platinum. Collectibles are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.

notes.title: Smoother Start
notes.content:
As requested by several players:

Early spaceship prices have been discounted to facilitate smoother progression.

Defeated bosses now grant 2x Science Points.

Reminder:
Starting from level 90, you can battle special bosses and unlock expeditions to earn Science Points and Credits.

notes.title: Small Update, better rewars and small fix
notes.content:
Mouse zoom no longer affects the application when in windowed mode outside the application.

Fixed a minor issue with expeditions.

Improved rewards for asteroids and special bosses.

Thanks every one for the feedback andenjoy the game.

ColmilloEstelar

notes.title: Smoother Start & New Language Added
notes.content:
As requested by "onasintetica", Catalan has been added to the list of supported languages.

After some reviews and constructive feedback, I decided to slightly lower the starting science costs: Total Damage now costs 2, and Click Damage costs 3. This should make early progression smoother and help players reach higher levels more easily.

Please remember I'm a solo developer, but I’ll do my best to keep the game updated and fun for everyone supporting my journey as an indie dev.

Thanks so much for all the support!
You can connect with me on X:
👉 https://x.com/RaulVRamos

Cheers,
ColmilloEstelar
